explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1138 and its disproof (Sunder–Kumrawat–Cheri–GPT). The statement negates, for all C > 1, π(y + Cd) - π(y) ~ Cd/log y as x → ∞ with x/2 < y < x. Here d = max_{p_n<x}(p_{n+1} - p_n), and sup_primeGap ranges over n < π'(⌈x⌉), which is exactly p_n < x. The page's counterexample (x = p_n + 1 at a record gap, y = p_n - 2d, 1 < C < 3) lies in the filter's region y ∈ (x/2, x) for large n, so the negation is correct and faithful.
